legend.en: Not trig. = entry zone never reached. Flat = entered, closed between stop and target. 3 d = three sessions later, information only. Wait row: what a buy would have made.
legend.id: Tdk terpicu = zona masuk tidak tercapai. Datar = masuk, tutup di antara stop dan target. 3 hr = tiga sesi kemudian, hanya info. Baris Tunggu: hasil seandainya beli.

rate_wait.en: a buy would have made {0} on average

few_n.en: {0} of {1} needed to show a rate

nomatch.id: Tidak ada verdict yang cocok dengan filter ini

nomatch_b.en: Opus and Sonnet usually split manual and automatic runs. Try fewer filters.
nomatch_b.id: Opus dan Sonnet biasanya dibagi antara analisis manual dan otomatis. Coba kurangi filter.

nohist_b.en: Your PC saves each Analyze verdict and scores it after the close, from 16:20. Run Analyze on a stock, then come back after the close.
nohist_b.id: PC kamu menyimpan tiap verdict Analisis dan menilainya setelah penutupan, mulai 16:20. Jalankan Analisis pada sebuah saham, lalu kembali setelah penutupan.

first_t.en: The record starts after the close

first_b.en: {0} verdicts from today are scored after 16:20. The first numbers appear then.
first_b.id: {0} verdict hari ini dinilai setelah 16:20. Angka pertama muncul saat itu.

off_sub.en: Saved copy from {0}, all verdicts. Filters need the PC.
off_sub.id: Salinan tersimpan dari {0}, semua verdict. Filter butuh PC.

footer.en: Scored from stored daily prices after 16:20. A past record is not a promise. Analysis only, not financial advice.
footer.id: Dinilai dari harga harian tersimpan setelah 16:20. Rekam jejak bukan janji. Hanya analisis, bukan nasihat keuangan.

line_few.en: AI record on {0}: not enough calls yet
line_few.id: Rekam AI untuk {0}: belum cukup verdict

line_none.en: No AI record yet · this verdict is scored after 16:20
line_none.id: Belum ada rekam AI · verdict ini dinilai setelah 16:20

past_empty_b.en: Each Analyze run is saved and scored after the close.
past_empty_b.id: Setiap analisis disimpan dan dinilai setelah penutupan.

sh_intro.en: Each AI verdict is checked against what the price did on the one trading day it was made for. It asks: did the idea work today?
sh_intro.id: Setiap verdict AI dicek dengan apa yang dilakukan harga pada satu hari perdagangan yang dituju. Pertanyaannya: apakah idenya berhasil hari ini?

sh_win_b.en: One trading session. A verdict made after the close counts for the next session. Scoring runs after 16:20, from the day's prices.
sh_win_b.id: Satu sesi perdagangan. Verdict yang dibuat setelah penutupan dihitung untuk sesi berikutnya. Penilaian berjalan setelah 16:20, dari harga hari itu.

sh_buy_b.en: Win: the price reached the target. Loss: it reached the stop-loss. Not triggered: the price never entered the entry zone, so it is neither a win nor a loss. Closed flat: it entered, then touched neither target nor stop before the close.
sh_buy_b.id: Menang: harga mencapai target. Kalah: harga mencapai stop-loss. Tidak terpicu: harga tidak pernah masuk zona masuk, jadi bukan menang dan bukan kalah. Tutup datar: harga masuk, lalu tidak menyentuh target maupun stop sebelum penutupan.

sh_both_t.en: Target and stop on the same day
sh_both_t.id: Target dan stop di hari yang sama

sh_both_b.en: The 5-minute prices of that day show which came first. When they are not available, the verdict counts as stop first, so a loss.
sh_both_b.id: Harga 5 menit hari itu menunjukkan mana yang lebih dulu. Jika tidak tersedia, verdict dihitung stop lebih dulu, jadi kalah.

sh_avoid_b.en: Right when the close at the end of the session is not above the price at the time of the verdict.
sh_avoid_b.id: Tepat jika harga penutupan di akhir sesi tidak di atas harga saat verdict dibuat.

sh_hold_b.en: Right when its stop is not hit by the close. With a target, reaching the target first counts as a win.
sh_hold_b.id: Tepat jika stop tidak tersentuh sampai penutupan. Jika ada target, mencapai target lebih dulu dihitung menang.

sh_wait_b.en: No right or wrong. It shows what a buy would have made: bought at the top of the entry zone, or at the price at the verdict when there was no zone, held to the close.
sh_wait_b.id: Tidak ada benar atau salah. Hanya menunjukkan hasil seandainya beli: di batas atas zona masuk, atau di harga saat verdict jika tidak ada zona, ditahan sampai penutupan.

sh_d3_b.en: A second result three trading days on, in grey. For information only: it is not in the counts or the rates.
sh_d3_b.id: Hasil kedua tiga hari perdagangan kemudian, berwarna abu-abu. Hanya info: tidak masuk hitungan atau angka.

sh_avg_b.en: The mean percent result of the verdicts that were not "not triggered". For Avoid and Sell it is the price move, so below 0 means the AI was right.
sh_avg_b.id: Rata-rata hasil persen dari verdict yang bukan "tidak terpicu". Untuk Hindari dan Jual ini adalah pergerakan harga, jadi di bawah 0 berarti AI tepat.

sh_min_b.en: Under 10 scored verdicts of one type, the rate and the average are not shown.
sh_min_b.id: Di bawah 10 verdict dinilai untuk satu jenis, angka dan rata-rata tidak ditampilkan.

sh_note.en: A past record is not a promise. Analysis only, not financial advice.
sh_note.id: Rekam jejak bukan janji. Hanya analisis, bukan nasihat keuangan.

summary.en: Broke above its 20-day high on volume 2.3 times the average; coal names are firm today.
summary.id: Menembus level tertinggi 20 hari dengan volume 2,3 kali rata-rata; saham batu bara kuat hari ini.

rs1.en: Last close 2.470 is above the 20-day high; volume is 2.3 times the 20-day average.
rs1.id: Penutupan terakhir 2.470 di atas level tertinggi 20 hari; volume 2,3 kali rata-rata 20 hari.

rs2.en: Coal prices firmed this week and two headlines name the company.
rs2.id: Harga batu bara menguat pekan ini dan dua berita menyebut perusahaan ini.

rs3.en: The stop at 2.400 is under the last two sessions' lows; the risk is about 3 %.
rs3.id: Stop di 2.400 berada di bawah titik terendah dua sesi terakhir; risikonya sekitar 3 %.
